cases.question: What is the annual leave policy and how many days can be carried forward?
cases.referenceAnswer: Employees receive 20 days of annual leave per calendar year. Up to 5 unused days may be carried forward into the next year.

cases.question: What equipment and home office stipend does the company provide for remote employees?
